No, generally you can't. Dresses tailored to your measurements can't be returned unless they have a defect [1].

If your dress is defective, a return is possible, and Studio Lumi covers the return shipping costs in that case [1]. For standard (non-custom) products, the return window is 14 days from the day you received the order, and the item must be unused, unwashed, and have its original tag [1].

The sources don't say how to report a defect or what counts as one. For those details, please contact Studio Lumi directly.

Based on the size chart, a 70 cm waist matches **size M** [1].

The chart also lists bust and hips for each size, so check those too. For size M, the bust is 88 cm and the hips are 96 cm [1]. If your measurements fall between two sizes, we recommend the larger one [1].

If your measurements don't fit one size, any dress can be tailored to your exact measurements. This costs an extra 1,500 MKD and adds 7 working days to delivery [1].

results.answer:
Delivery to Kosovo normally takes 4 to 6 working days [1]. Custom tailoring adds 7 working days to the delivery time [3][4]. So your tailored dress should arrive in about 11 to 13 working days.

A few other details from our shipping information:
- Every order gets a tracking number by email on the day it ships [2].
- Orders placed after 14:00 are shipped the next working day [2].

The sources don't say whether the 7 tailoring days are counted from the order date or from when the order is shipped, so the exact timing may vary slightly.
